$comment: Named plugin subsets for the installers. Every marketplace plugin belongs to exactly one profile (scripts/validate.py checks this). install-copilot.sh/.ps1 default to copilotDefault; install.sh/.ps1 keep installing every plugin unless --profile is given. claude-only plugins rely on Claude Code features (Workflow engine, !`cmd` injection, Claude-only hook events) and are skipped by install-copilot unless named explicitly.
